summary: The note describes Game Park, a South Korean company founded in 1996 that went bankrupt in March 2007. It is credited with creating the GP32 handheld and the never-released XGP. The note also says GamePark Holdings was founded in 2005 by former Game Park employees.
one_line: Game Park was a South Korean company (1996–2007) that created the GP32 handheld and the unreleased XGP.
key_facts: Game Park was a South Korean company.
Game Park went bankrupt in March 2007.
